title: Native Ringed Restriction Divisibility
statement: For a dense equivalence F:C→D of sites, a commutative ring sheaf R on D, a compatible global section a, U in C and a compatible section s on D/FU, s is locally divisible by a on a covering sieve if and only if its restricted section on C/U is locally divisible by the restricted a. This holds for zero sections, arbitrary covering sieves, and independent site and coefficient universes. Dependencies: [lem-pur-native-ringed-restriction-localization], [def-pur-ringed-principal-local-tests], [lem-pur-native-ringed-restriction-slices].

proof.text: Local principal divisibility is preserved and reflected by restriction. Pull back a covering sieve along the dense equivalence for one direction. For the converse push it forward; a resulting arrow factors through an image arrow, and naturality transports its chosen quotient along that factor. This works also for the zero generator and empty covers. Source: Stacks 03A0, 03CH, 03DA, 03DG and 0999.

lean.statement:
theorem localDivisibilityRestriction
    (a : (R.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) (U : C)
    (s : ((R.over (F.obj U)).obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) :
    principalLocallyDivisible.{d, vd, max c vc r} R a (F.obj U) s ↔
      principalLocallyDivisible.{c, vc, max d vd r}
        (restrictedCommRing.{c, d, vc, vd, r} (K := K) F R)
        (restrictedSection.{c, d, vc, vd, r} (K := K) F R a) U
        (restrictedSection.{max c vc, max d vd, vc, vd, r}
          (K := K.over U) (Over.post F) (R.over (F.obj U)) s)
